Ollama has become the standard for running Large Language Models (LLMs) locally. In this tutorial, I want to show you the most important things you should know about Ollama.




Watch on YouTube: Ollama Full Tutorial
Ollama is an open-source platform for running and managing large-language-model (LLM) packages entirely on your local machine. It bundles model weights, configuration, and data into a single Modelfile package. Ollama offers a command-line interface (CLI), a REST API, and a Python/JavaScript SDK, allowing users to download models, run them offline, and even call user-defined functions. Running models locally gives users privacy, removes network latency, and keeps data on the user’s device.

articles.author: Jaideep Parashar
articles.description:
As the Founder of ReThynk AI, I’ve noticed something uncomfortable.
Inside companies, the AI divide is not:
paid tools vs free tools
technical vs non-technical
prompt experts vs beginners
The real divide is: people who can clearly define what they want vs people who can’t.
AI rewards clarity.
If I can define:
the outcome
the audience
the constraints
the standard of quality
AI becomes predictable.
If I can’t define those things, AI becomes random.
That’s why some teams say: “AI is magic.”
And others say: “AI is useless.”
Same tool. Different clarity.
So for businesses, democratisation of AI doesn’t start with buying tools. It starts with building a culture of clear thinking:
clear goals
clear owners
clear definitions of done
clear review standards
When clarity becomes normal, AI becomes leverage for everyone: marketing, sales, HR, operations.
That’s the real democratisation: making AI work for normal people inside normal teams.
articles.title: The Real AI Divide Inside Companies is Clarity, Not Tools
